bullets.0: HTTP status, title and meta description

projectSiteAudit.summary: {pages, number} pages fetched · {errors, number} errors · {warnings, number} warnings · {indexable, number} confirmed indexable
projectSiteAudit.partial: Incomplete audit: reached the {reason}. Results cover only the pages fetched.
projectSiteAudit.limitations: HTTP crawl only; JavaScript rendering and Lighthouse are not included. Indexability uses HTTP status, meta robots and X-Robots-Tag; canonical and search-engine indexing are not verified. Only the project origin and URLs without query strings are crawled. Links and headings are bounded samples.

issues.missing_image_alt: {count, number} images have no alt attribute.
issues.non_html: Response is not HTML; on-page checks are unavailable.
issues.robots_disallowed: Crawl skipped because robots.txt disallows this URL.
issues.fetch_failed: Page could not be fetched within the safe crawl limits.
issues.broken_internal_link: {count, number} sampled internal links returned HTTP errors.

projectSiteAudit.errorRun: Site audit could not be completed. Try again.
projectSiteAudit.unavailableSummary: {pages, number} pages fetched · {unavailable, number} not fetched · {errors, number} errors · {warnings, number} warnings · {indexable, number} confirmed indexable
projectSiteAudit.partialUnavailable: Incomplete audit: some pages or robots.txt could not be fetched. Unavailable pages have no measured SEO results.

fetchReasons.timeout: The page request timed out. Try again later.
fetchReasons.dns: The public hostname could not be resolved. Check the domain and its DNS records.
fetchReasons.tls: The secure connection could not be verified. Check the site certificate.
fetchReasons.network: The connection to the page failed. Try again later.
fetchReasons.public_network: The URL failed the public-network safety check. Check that the domain resolves only to public addresses.
fetchReasons.redirect: The redirect leaves the project origin or uses a blocked URL. Check the project domain and redirect destination.
fetchReasons.redirect_limit: The page exceeded the three-redirect limit. Check the redirect chain.
fetchReasons.size_limit: The response exceeded the 512 KiB limit. This page could not be assessed.
fetchReasons.request_limit: The crawl reached its request limit before this page could be fetched.
fetchReasons.unknown: The page could not be fetched. Its HTTP status and SEO measurements are unknown.
